PLUS rejects 0^0 in MathI and LineI. 0^(-1), negative even root and zero root index are Math ERROR; cube root of -8 is -2. 10^99 and e^230 are valid, 10^100 and e^231 overflow; Back tested.
Log/ln domain errors return before closing parenthesis; repair from log(0) to log(1) and from LineI log(2,-8) to log(2,8)=3 verified. MathI base-one error can be repaired to base two.
LineI log key inserts log(, accepting one argument for log10 or two comma-separated arguments (base,argument). log(0,2) errors, log(0.5,8)=-3, log(100)=2.

ln at 1.000000000001 and 0.999999999999 uses a decimal-rational difference before log1p to avoid binary cancellation, PLUS only. log10(1.000000000001)=4.342944819e-13; log10(1e-99)=-99. No all-hidden-digit precision claim.
